notes.title: Layers of Fear 2 - Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/dyRQ4qetpAgQGQaN7X/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Layers of Fear 2 - Patch 1.2[/h1]

The team has prepared our second patch, deployed today, to address a few key issues found in Layers of Fear 2 on PC.

Patch 1.2
[list]
[*]FIXED - Formless Man - Various "Instant Death" Encounters
[*]FIXED - Various Lighting Issues
[*]TUNED - Further Fine Tuning of the Formless Man Behavior and Difficulty
[*]TUNED - Performance and Quality Adjustments
[*]TUNED - Pacing Adjustments - Several Acts
[*]TUNED - Black and White Post Processing - Adjusted in Chapter 2
[*]TUNED - Perfect Storm Achievement 
[*]NEW - 'NG+ Unlocked' Pop Up with Info Added to Game Ending
[/list]
This patch is now live, so please restart the title and check for updates!

-Layers of Fear 2 Dev Team

notes.title: Layers of Fear 2 - Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Qv3x6fInv1SbH9v4bk/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Layers of Fear 2 - Patch 1.1[/h1]

We have a hotfix patch incoming for Layers of Fear 2 on PC to repair and tune a few key elements uncovered in our first week, post-launch.

[b]Patch 1.1[/b]
[list]
[*]FIXED - Several Issues with Formless Man Behavior
[*]FIXED - Various Lighting Issues 
[*]FIXED - Involuntary Resolution Changes After Player Death
[*]FIXED - Minor Bug Fixes in Multiple Acts
[*]FIXED - Letter Spacing for ъ, ь, э, я
[*]TUNED - Formless Man Difficulty Decreased
[*]TUNED - Max Value for FOV Increased by 5%
[*]TUNED - Default Controller Sensitivity Increased by 10%
[/list]

The patch will go live immediately, so please restart the title and check for updates!

-Layers of Fear 2 Dev Team
